name: Abyss
description: A slowly evolving drone and pad instrument: hold a note and it opens from a sine into a deep, moving pad (or sinks from bright into the dark). 24 drifting sine partials per voice with a wandering spectral bloom, stretch and hollow, detuned twins, sub, an interval layer and shimmer, air, a slow motion cycle in four shapes (free or synced to the song), Orbit (each note's halves circling each other) and a lush built-in reverb; 6 voices, 16 programs.
author: Groundswell
